//: COMMITTED AND SECRET-FREE. This file declares structure and safe defaults only.
Seed:AdminPassword) are supplied by user-secrets in Development and environment variables in
Production. Any value here can be overridden by an env var using the double-underscore form,
Provider: Local | R2. Cloudflare R2 is S3-compatible, so the same adapter also works against
AWS S3, MinIO or DigitalOcean Spaces by changing ServiceUrl.
RootPath MUST stay outside wwwroot: UseStaticFiles() serves the web root publicly, and CVs are
personal data. LocalStorage refuses to start if this resolves inside wwwroot.
